documents.content: Dx: atopic dermatitis L20.9. IGA 3. BSA 18%. Prescriber specialty: dermatology. Prior therapies: 'topical steroids, tacrolimus — inadequate response.' No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

03/02/2026: Start triamcinolone 0.1% cream BID to affected areas. 04/20/2026 f/u: minimal improvement after 7 wks, IGA 3, d/c triamcinolone. Start tacrolimus 0.1% ointment BID. 05/01/2026: confirmed pt started tacrolimus 04/21. 06/30/2026 f/u: tacrolimus x ~10 wks, mild burning but tolerated, inadequate response, IGA 3, BSA 18%. Plan: biologic, dupilumab.

Resubmission after initial ST-DOC denial (09/22). Includes chart notes: betamethasone valerate 0.1% cream 01/05/2026-02/20/2026 inadequate; tacrolimus 0.1% ointment 03/01/2026-04/30/2026 inadequate. IGA 4, BSA 32%. Dermatologist.

Dx: rheumatoid arthritis M06.9, rheumatologist. Prior: methotrexate 20 mg/wk 01/2025-06/2025, inadequate response. Current: Humira 40 mg q2w since 08/2025, good response. Request: continuation of brand Humira (plan change; new to Bluepeak 10/2026).

Med history: methotrexate 01/2025-06/2025 (inadequate, DAS28 5.1). Humira started 08/12/2025. 02/2026 f/u: DAS28 2.4, doing well on Humira, continue. 08/2026 f/u: stable, continue Humira. No other biologics listed.

Dx: atopic dermatitis L20.9, 'moderate-severe, widespread'. Prescriber: allergist. Step therapy: clobetasol 0.05% ointment 02/10/2026-03/24/2026 inadequate; pimecrolimus 1% cream 04/01/2026-05/15/2026 inadequate. No concurrent biologic.
Trial notes for clobetasol and pimecrolimus as listed on PA form, with outcomes. Exam 09/2026: 'extensive eczematous plaques trunk, arms, legs.' No IGA or BSA recorded.
Dx: rheumatoid arthritis M06.9, seropositive, rheumatologist. Prior DMARDs: hydroxychloroquine 6 mo, inadequate. Methotrexate: not trialed (see notes).

09/2026: ALT 58 U/L (ULN 40, ~1.4x), AST normal. Hx of NAFLD on US 2024. Moderate alcohol use (reports 5-7 drinks/wk). Discussed MTX hepatotoxicity risk; patient prefers to avoid MTX. Plan: proceed to TNF inhibitor.
Dx: RA M06.9, rheumatologist. MTX 20 mg/wk 12/2025-04/2026 inadequate. Insurance on file: Bluepeak Commercial, member ID BP-xxxx-2231 (from 2025 intake).

10/15/2026 visit: extensive eczematous plaques on arms, legs and neck. IGA 4. BSA 22%. Plan: continue pursuing dupilumab.

Dx: rheumatoid arthritis M06.9, rheumatologist. Prior: methotrexate 20 mg/wk 02/2024-08/2024, inadequate (DAS28 5.4). adalimumab-adaz 40 mg q2w 10/2024-01/2025, discontinued for intolerance (see chart). Request: Humira brand.

11/2024: injection-site reactions with each adalimumab-adaz dose. 01/06/2025: generalized urticaria after 6th dose. Assessment: intolerance to adalimumab-adaz, likely excipient-related; discontinue. 02/2025: started Humira (citrate-free), tolerating well. 08/2026: DAS28 2.6, continue.

Dx: atopic dermatitis L20.9, IGA 3, BSA 15%, allergist. TCS: fluocinonide 0.05% ointment 04/01/2026-05/15/2026, inadequate. TCI: not trialed, contraindicated (see letter). No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

Patient has recurrent eczema herpeticum: three episodes, most recent 06/2026, which required IV acyclovir. Given this history, topical calcineurin inhibitors are contraindicated for this patient. Signed, Dr. Hannah Okafor, Allergy & Immunology.

Hi Forus team,

Following up on the Dupixent request for our patient Daniel Okoro (DOB 06/27/1991).

He used fluocinonide 0.05% ointment from April 1 to May 15 this year without enough improvement.

Thanks,
Dana R., front desk, Metro Allergy Partners
